Author: Serpens66
Name: CastlePlanner
Description: Displays AIVJSON blueprints, spawns personal human castles, and contains the gated AI lobby placement workflow.

Changes: Adds read-only diagnostics for Vanilla's rotated Keep, Keep door, campground, goods-yard components, Lord initialization state, and the first selected-player unit creation attempts.
Records the start complex immediately before and after native AIV execution so rotation-anchor errors can be distinguished from later building collisions without moving or creating units.

Prepares the selected human AIV castle before Vanilla first reads the Keep coordinates, so the Keep, start complex, flag, Lord, starting units, and peasants share the rotated anchor from the beginning.
Removes the post-placement Keep and Keep-door anchor correction while retaining immediate native castle execution during the normal map-start path.
Restores the proven immediate native castle execution after an early Keep-door anchor check incorrectly identified Vanilla's campground and aborted every selected AIV castle.
Rotates Vanilla's own start flag with the selected human Keep while leaving supplemental AIV flags on their existing deterministic placement path.
Restores immediate native AIV castle execution during map start instead of delaying construction until after the Lord appears.

Synchronizes Vanilla's persistent Keep and Keep-door anchors with the actually rotated Keep components before castle construction, so the Lord, starting units, and later peasants use the rotated entrance.
Removes the broad UnitCreate position workaround; the verified delayed-spawn mechanism remains documented in code for future diagnosis.
Defers native AIV castle construction until Vanilla has successfully created the human Lord, keeping the original pre-create search area unobstructed.
Preserves the prepared rotation through map start and logs each early Vanilla unit position, Lord completion, and deferred castle execution for diagnosis.
Rotates Vanilla Lord and starting-unit spawn positions from the original Keep reserve into the matching rotated reserve.
Recalculates starter-unit height at the rotated destination so buildings in the former unrotated campfire area cannot suppress the Lord spawn.
Anchors all supplemental AIV objects to Vanilla's original fixed-grid reference instead of the rotated live Keep footprint.
Prevents the common rotation-dependent offset of siege engines, braziers, flags, stockpiles, and supplemental Fearfactor objects.
Places AIV braziers and flags at their intended tiles by converting tile positions to the projectile system's eighth-tile coordinates.
Aligns rotated in-game blueprints to the live Keep footprint while preserving Vanilla's fixed-grid castle rotation.
Spawns AIV braziers and owner-specific flags as Vanilla projectile objects instead of sending them through the building-prefab path.
Skips duplicate decorations already present on the same tile and validates all player-specific flag mapper assignments.
Keeps the normal in-game blueprint aligned with the live Keep position and the rotation selected for the spawned castle.
Removes troop and engineer spawning, including the former host option, so every soldier must be recruited normally.
Keeps AIV siege-engine spawning optional but no longer creates automatic engineer crews.
Keeps supplemental AIV stockpiles governed by the ordinary-building option.
Spawns the required engineer crew beside every enabled AIV siege engine, independently of the troop setting.
Creates AIV stockpiles through the complete prefab path when ordinary buildings are enabled, including their connected yard parts.
Treats every AIV misc slot as exactly one unit and records its slot index in deterministic spawn diagnostics.
Separates personal AIV castle spawning into fortifications, ordinary buildings, defensive ground features, Fearfactor buildings, siege engines, troops, and personal braziers or flags.
Filters native AIV frames before Vanilla's fit test and deterministically creates supplemental Fearfactor and misc objects after native castle execution.
Builds and synchronizes the cached AIVJSON inventory automatically in the lobby, resets incompatible persisted personal selections to No castle, and validates only selected castle files at map start.

Uses the local castle selection and inventory in confirmed singleplayer skirmishes while preserving synchronized per-player validation for real multiplayer games, including sessions with only one human player.
Keeps AIV placement evaluation and status display while leaving candidate capacity, multiplayer transfer, and Vanilla best-fit selection to Bugfixes and QoL.
Keeps the separate host and local-client activation switches visible directly beside their section headings.
Isolated settings, Blueprint, AIV placement, and native Spawn initialization; made AIV hook installation transactional and disabled Blueprint frame work when inactive.
Removed the explicit ComboBoxItem container style entirely so the game renders its untouched dropdown theme instead of Noesis' pink fallback.
Kept incompatible multiplayer entries gray in the data template and rejected attempts to select them in the bound setting.
Forced the themed Noesis ComboBox popup to Bottom placement before opening and kept its height within the measured space below the selector.
Preserved the game's existing ComboBoxItem theme while adding gray multiplayer availability state, removing the pink Noesis fallback appearance.
Restored the proven dynamic popup-height workaround so the dropdown stays below the opening click instead of reopening upward and closing immediately.
Restored the proven data-value ComboBox binding used by the working August 20 CastlePlanner selector.
Removed generated Noesis ComboBoxItem controls and custom selection interception while retaining disabled gray multiplayer entries.
Made No castle the reliable default and changed the AIVJSON selector to index-based selection.
Kept the dropdown at its normal height from the first opening.
Cached AIVJSON discovery when mod settings first open and removed content-identical files from both the list and count.
Continued rebuilding multiplayer availability from cached participant manifests when the lobby roster changes.
Integrated the complete AIV Placement Lobby code, tests, Vanilla AIV catalog, and lobby UI into CastlePlanner behind a hidden host setting that remains disabled by default.
Preferred effective Script Extender AIV overrides over bundled Vanilla files for both CastlePlanner and lobby placement evaluation.
Fixed the spawn selector width and selection handling, added bundled Vanilla castles, and described incompatible multiplayer entries as gray.
Kept host and local-client activation controls distinct across mixed CastlePlanner settings.
Resolve map-start human players exclusively from synchronized in-game members while excluding kicked and defeated slots.
Removed local and simulation-derived player fallbacks that could produce different castle plans on multiplayer peers.
Hardened personal castle synchronization for joins, leaves, reused player IDs, and selections made before joining.
Added a host-authenticated lobby resync request and stable fail-closed map-start validation without last-second broadcasts.
Preserved Workshop selections until Steam discovery and cached file fingerprints plus decoded inventories for large catalogs.
Added deterministic personal AIVJSON castle spawning for every human player in multiplayer skirmishes.
Kept Spawn Castle host-controlled while synchronizing each player's own castle selection.
Compared lobby AIVJSON inventories by catalog name and SHA-256, disabled incompatible entries, and reset invalid selections to No castle.
Enabled the local Blueprint HUD in the map editor and re-anchored it to the Keep of EditorDirector.ActivePlayerID whenever the active editor player changes.
Treats an unavailable local AIVJSON as an optional Blueprint limitation instead of an error while the host Spawn Castle setting is disabled.
Defers Steam Workshop discovery until Steamworks is initialized and preserves saved Workshop AIV selections until the complete dropdown refresh.
Discovers AIVJSON castles inside subscribed Steam Workshop items and refreshes the preserved selection whenever the castle dropdown opens.
Replaced the exclusive Blueprint or Spawn mode dropdown with independent Blueprint and Spawn Castle checkboxes.
Made Spawn Castle a synchronized host setting while keeping Blueprints and the AIVJSON selection local.
Added separate preset-aware activation gates for local Blueprint features and host-controlled CastlePlanner features.
Presented Blueprints and Spawn Castle as regular feature options instead of using them as the mod activation controls.
Separated the synchronized host Spawn Castle AIV selection from each player's local in-game Blueprint AIV selection.
Listed local Blueprint settings before host-controlled Spawn Castle settings and enabled Blueprints by default.
Added optional Serps Mods Host dependency for Workshop mod-pack load ordering.
Updated shared lobby settings for Script Extender 1.42.0 by avoiding redundant UI-only persistence and using the official multiplayer-game signal.
Removed the nonfunctional early MonoBehaviour and Script Extender dispatcher frame-loop fallbacks from Blueprint mode.
Kept the verified Application.onBeforeRender callback as the sole process-lifetime Blueprint frame source because the Script Extender dispatcher is not intended as a frame host.
Highlighted the local activation control and standardized larger, wider settings tooltips.
Grouped local settings into castle-blueprint and placement-control sections and added opaque wrapping tooltips.
Added the shared Enable Mod, local presets, and Reset to Default controls to CastlePlanner settings.
Replaced the redundant Disabled mode with a separately persisted enable setting and Blueprint or Spawn modes.
Migrated legacy local settings once into the shared preset format while keeping the Blueprint window position in independent runtime storage.
Localized CastlePlanner lobby and in-game Blueprint settings, including complete German labels and help texts.
Use locally validated reference RVAs instead of full native signature scans on the supported DLL.
Added a Mod Settings dropdown for AIVJSON files from the mod folder, CustomLords, ExtendedLords, and the official Castle Editor.
Added automatic singleplayer castle spawning around the existing human keep after a new map starts.
Added savegame duplication protection and detailed millisecond-timestamped spawn diagnostics.
Removed the false-positive network-environment spawn block that also affected regular skirmish starts.
Promoted lifecycle and per-placement diagnostics to Info level.
Replaced Unity JsonUtility with a dependency-free AIVJSON reader after JsonUtility returned empty frame lists.
Added strict JSON error positions and support for safely skipping future unknown properties.
Corrected the inverted AIV editor row when mapping castle positions to world tile Y coordinates.
Grouped connected wall tiles into real line segments and added immediate tile-flag verification.
Added a building-footprint preflight check and temporary free wall placement with guaranteed cost restoration.
Anchored AIV placement to the real keep building begin tile found in the building array instead of relying on the player-resource keep tile.
Added side-by-side diagnostics for the reported keep id, resource tile, door tile, and actual keep footprint.
Deferred wall spawning while building placement is tested and removed all wall-cost multiplier changes.
Persisted the locally selected AIVJSON blueprint in the BepInEx configuration across game restarts.
Validated restored selections against the current AIV file catalog and safely falls back to disabled when a file disappeared.
Documented the verified real-keep anchor and world-coordinate conversion used for building spawning.
Moved AIVJSON selection persistence from BepInEx cfg to the Script Extender LobbyModSettings storage used by other mod settings.
Stored the host selection in CastlePlanner_Serp.msgpack next to the plugin and restored it before the settings UI is bound.
Kept catalog validation and the safe disabled fallback for missing AIVJSON files.
Replaced individual CreatePrefab, wall, moat, pitch, and trap spawning with the native AIV pipeline used by Completed enemy castles.
Added native AIVJSON encoding, Vanilla placement and rotation selection, layout preparation, and 100 percent castle execution.
Version-gated all private native calls with a CrusaderDE.dll SHA-256 check and unique AOB signatures.
Removed the old managed placement path completely; native failures do not fall back to CreatePrefab.
Limited native spawning to new singleplayer maps to avoid savegame duplication and multiplayer desynchronization.
Replaced the unreliable alive-human slot count with game-mode, lobby-member, and real Steam game-member detection.
Allowed local singleplayer skirmishes even though Vanilla creates a local gameMembers list and the Script Extender reports a networked environment.
Added detailed Director, map-start, network, lobby, game-member, GameData, local-player, and alive-slot diagnostics.
Stopped requiring Director.SkirmishModeGame during the early native map-start callback, where Vanilla has not set it yet.
Recognized local singleplayer skirmishes through their all-skirmish pseudo-lobby and nonnegative GameData skirmish type.
Preserved LobbyModSettings during build.bat deployments instead of deleting runtime-created settings with the plugin directory.
Added settings-file and restored-selection diagnostics around LobbyModSettings registration.
Moved the selected human AIV import from OnStartMap Post to OnStartMap Pre, after Vanilla clears and loads the candidate table but before the native start consumes it.
Split AIV preparation/import and native placement/execution across the map-start Pre and Post phases.
Added explicit pre-import readiness, player-slot consistency, and phase diagnostics.
Added direct diagnostics for the native eight-by-1000 AIV candidate pointer table immediately after import and before placement.
Classified native -2 placement failures as either a missing candidate or a present candidate rejected by the map-fit test.
Logged the native value copied into the allocated human AIV specification to distinguish import-state and placement-state failures.
Moved native AIV fit selection and layout preparation into the local Keep OnBuildStructure Pre event, before Vanilla occupies the Keep footprint.
Reused Vanilla's prepared Keep coordinates and orientation for the human Keep, matching the native completed-AI-castle order.
Kept 100 percent AIV execution in OnStartMap Post and added separate preparation, Keep interception, and execution diagnostics.
Moved 100 percent AIV execution from OnStartMap Post to the local Keep OnBuildStructure Post event, while the native skirmish-start function is still running.
Aligned castle construction with Vanilla's completed-AI-castle timing so later native startup can finalize building tiles and visuals.
Added detailed Granary and Hovel diagnostics for alive state, footprint, sprite color, variation, and health.
Corrected native AIV Hovel visual styles for the human player from the AI-only sentinel value 15 to Vanilla's deterministic 0-through-6 variation cycle.
Scoped the correction strictly to Hovel BuildStructure calls made synchronously by CastlePlanner's native AIV execution.
Added Hovel visual-style and material diagnostics without changing the player's internal AI-control state.
Added Disabled, Blueprint, and Spawn modes with fully local persistence through the BepInEx configuration.
Added a non-simulating Blueprint mode with translucent ground footprints and original build-menu sketch images anchored to the human Keep.
Added a MainHUD visibility toggle, an optional freely assignable Unity KeyCode, map-rotation rebuilding, savegame support, and client-local multiplayer behavior.
Moved Blueprint ticking and key capture onto the Script Extender's process-lifetime dispatcher so they survive startup.
Made map-start HUD availability and initial Blueprint preparation event-driven.
Restored the AIVJSON selector to its previous dialog position to prevent popup overlap and accidental immediate selection.
Made Blueprint key assignment work while Noesis owns input focus by combining Vanilla's selector with held-state polling.
Replaced large building sketch images with the normal non-highlighted UI-MasterAtlas build-menu icons.
Added the previously unknown Woodsman, Dunking Stool, and Pond AIV mapper definitions.
Captured keyboard and mouse assignment directly from Noesis settings events and added the persistent component's own polling fallback.
Added dedicated visible SpriteRenderer ground markers instead of relying only on the game's hidden overlay tile layer.
Switched dynamic build-menu icons to Unity's standard sprite material and added atlas-pixel validation.
Linked Blueprint icons directly to Vanilla's Unity UI-MasterAtlas texture after Noesis CroppedBitmap pixel copies proved empty.
Added bubbling KeyDown capture and persistent Application.onBeforeRender input polling for keyboard assignment.
Kept the colored footprint markers beneath the newly restored normal build-menu icons.
Corrected every 64x32 Blueprint ground marker to one SHCDE tile by using 64 pixels per unit.
Centered footprint markers on Tilemap cell centers while retaining terrain height and Vanilla's proven depth value.
Removed duplicate Tilemap overlay writes and documented the process-persistent Noesis hotkey implementation.
Added normal Vanilla build-menu icons for walls, crenellations, all stair directions, killing pits, pitch ditches, and moats.
Created Blueprint icons for every mapped construction placement instead of limiting icons to regular building footprints.
Centered every one-cell Blueprint icon on its exact ground tile and constrained it to that tile's 1x0.5 world footprint.
Hidden Blueprint icons in Vanilla's flattened-landscape view while keeping all colored ground footprints visible.
Added a delayed projection refresh after map-view changes so Vanilla can finish flattening or rotating before the final overlay rebuild.
Centered regular building icons on the geometric center of their actual footprint cells instead of Vanilla's offset building-sprite pivot.
Aligned perspective building icons by their visible ground-contact point so their bases are centered on the complete footprint.
Kept flat one-cell construction icons centered by their rectangular image midpoint.
Delayed the final Blueprint projection refresh for 0.75 seconds after map-view changes so Vanilla can fully restore terrain heights and Tilemap transforms.
Restarted the settle delay when another rotation or flattened-landscape change occurs while retaining the immediate transition rebuild.
Hid the complete Blueprint overlay while Vanilla restores normal terrain after leaving flattened-landscape view, preventing the stale projection from flashing before the settled rebuild.
Aligned regular build-menu icons to a fixed ground-contact pixel baseline so differently cropped images such as the Church and Mercenary Post remain centered on their colored footprints.
Separated regular Blueprint building scale in the normal landscape view from the former footprint-height compression.
Restored the former compact Blueprint icons in flattened-landscape view while keeping walls, traps, moats, and other one-cell construction images compact in both views.
Corrected normal-view building scale for the build-menu crops, whose pixel dimensions are approximately half those of Vanilla's 64-PPU world sprites.
Rendered regular buildings at 32 PPU so Churches and other Blueprint buildings regain their intended full world size without changing compact flattened-view icons.
Replaced the incorrect global build-menu scale with an individual scale derived from each icon width and its AIV footprint.
Validated the calculation against matching fragments from Vanilla's 64-PPU building, workshop, church, castle, and animation sprites.
Excluded farm crop clearances from visual scaling while retaining the former compact icons in flattened-landscape view.
Added automatic per-building size calibration from Vanilla's transparent construction preview while a building is held at the mouse cursor.
Persisted measured world dimensions by mapper and immediately refreshed visible Blueprint icons after a stable preview measurement.
Kept the footprint-derived scale only as a fallback for buildings that have not yet been shown in Vanilla's construction preview.
Corrected calibration to measure Vanilla's complete cursor-rendered building preview instead of the colored placement footprint.
Excluded ordinary one-tile ground sprites from the fallback preview measurement.
Created build-menu sprites with tight meshes so transparent atlas margins no longer make Blueprint buildings visibly too small.
Removed synchronous Tight-mesh generation that could freeze the game for roughly one second per unique UI-atlas crop when enabling a large Blueprint.
Used both measured preview width and height for uniform building scale, selecting the larger required factor so sliced previews such as the Inn retain their full visual extent.
Kept the filtered extended-tile preview measurement and reused already stored two-dimensional calibration values.
Excluded Barracks, Engineers Guild, and Oil Smelter placement reservations from building-icon scale calculations.
Scaled reserved-area buildings from their core footprint while retaining every reserved tile as a colored Blueprint ground marker.
Applied a small 10 percent visual correction to calibrated regular buildings whose sliced Vanilla preview bounds remained slightly too small.
Used the manually selected clean Vanilla Help images for normal-view Blueprint buildings while retaining compact build-menu icons in flattened view.
Added alpha trimming, source-specific cleanup for corrupt workshop image borders, cached FullRect sprites, and safe build-menu fallbacks.
Selected Church and Mosque images from Vanilla's lord-type condition and restricted preview calibration to each building's core footprint.
Versioned saved calibration measurements so legacy Barracks, Engineers Guild, and Oil Smelter reservation bounds cannot enlarge their Blueprint images.
Excluded Vanilla's tinted 64x32 placement-ground sprites from automatic building-preview calibration while retaining the core-footprint restriction.
Ignored faulty revision 2 measurements that made Blueprint buildings such as the Dog Cage, Granary, and Inn substantially too small.
Preserved useful revision 1 measurements for ordinary buildings and introduced revision 3 for newly measured preview graphics.
Restored measurement of Vanilla's complete cursor-rendered building preview with the proven wide changed-sprite fallback for ordinary buildings.
Required reservation-bearing Barracks, Engineers Guild, and Oil Smelter to use cursor-renderer bounds so their yards cannot enlarge Blueprint images.
Ignored faulty revision 2 and 3 measurements, retained valid revision 1 ordinary-building bounds, and introduced revision 4 calibration.

Applied the same proven scan to reservation-bearing buildings while rejecting characteristic yard-sized or overly dense results.
Reused the Stone Barracks calibration for the non-buildable Mercenary Post and limited accepted saved measurements to revision 4 or newer.
Marked the complete 10x10 Barracks, 5x10 Guild, and 4x8 Oil Smelter placement reservations with colored Blueprint ground tiles.
Kept reserved-area building images centered on their original 5x5 or 4x4 core footprints instead of the enlarged marker bounds.
Disabled development-time Blueprint image and manifest generation behind one central source switch while continuing to load the bundled BlueprintImages library.

Removed obsolete capture view values, unused manifest-origin state, and stale model metadata.

Retained compact Vanilla icons as a safe fallback when a captured image cannot be read or projected.
Kept flattened Blueprint artwork aligned to the screen like its normal-view capture instead of rotating its contents along the diagonal AIV grid axes.
Continued using the exact isometric footprint as a clipping mask so the corrected image cannot extend beyond the colored placement area.
Extended the in-game Blueprint toggle with an AIVJSON selector plus live icon scale and alpha controls.
Persisted the normal-view icon scale and icon alpha locally with defaults of 1.0 and 0.3.
Kept flattened-view geometry and colored ground markers independent from the configurable normal-view icon scale.
Applied the configurable Blueprint icon scale to both normal and flattened map views.

Kept the manually verified wall composites protected while generating deterministic one-fragment atlas visuals from them.
